author: Zoe_The_Great
body: My name is xXQueen_ZoeXx. I was banned I think it was permanently(not totally sure though) for using hacks that I didn't. I was glitching out because my brother was using the WiFi to andIi was using the fly hack just to annoy my him because he was using all of it but I dont use most of the hacks I got banned for anymore and I wasn't using them for any game related advantages. I was also banned for using speed(I wasn't), kill aura(I dont know what that is and i dont think I was using it), toggle sneak(I wasnt), and no slow down(dont know what that is).  So thank you very much I promise I wont hack again on this server and I really hope you consider unbanning me because this is one of my favorite servers.  Thanks  =D

title: Appealing

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello xXQueen_ZoeXx,

I'm currently uploading the evidence for your ban. It might take some time until it's fully processed and you can watch it. As soon it is uploaded I'll post it in this thread/appeal.

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello xXQueen_ZoeXx,

The evidence is uploaded and you can access it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8zHoDLDfG7Q
The Appeal is now in the next state, this means a senior moderator will read your appeal and watch the evidence provided by me.
If the senior moderator thinks the evidence is inconclusive or the ban was invalid, the punishment will be appealed.
If the senior staff member thinks that the ban is in fact valid you'll not be appealed and you can re-submit the appeal in around 6-7 months.

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, xXQueen_ZoeXx.

What we can observe in the video evidence recorded is not glitching by any chance. Blurting our lies in your appeals will not help your case. Anyhow, the evidence provided is valid, meaning your appeal will be denied. As resepignev stated, you'll have to wait at least six months before issuing a new appeal. Make sure to be honest next time. Hopefully this serves to you as a lesson for you to reflect upon your mistake.

Sincerely,
- Evocal | Senior Moderator
